title: Principal AI Research Engineer, Customer World Model & Proactive Intelligence
description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.
 The Team
 Apollo leads Block's work on the Customer World Model : a continuously evolving representation of each customer's goals, context, history, constraints, and likely future needs. The Customer World Model powers Proactive Intelligence across Block's ecosystem, including Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. Instead of customers searching through products for the feature they need, the system understands what matters to them, anticipates what comes next, and takes timely action that improves their outcomes. Both are top priorities for Block.
 The Role
 We're hiring exceptional AI Researchers to take Customer World Model and Proactive Intelligence from promising research to reliable production systems. You'll set the technical direction, solve the hardest research and engineering problems, and own delivery all the way through production integration. The scope covers customer representations, forecasts, decision models, evaluation, real-time serving, and integration into the products customers use every day.

title: Director of User Experience (UX) Research
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 Discord is hiring a Director of User Experience Research to lead our research team, drive a user-centered understanding of Players (the people who use Discord), and turn that understanding into a better product. You'll own the research strategy for Discord, build and lead a team of researchers, and make sure a deep, evidence-based understanding of user needs shapes what we build before decisions are made.
 You'll uncover and forecast the problems our users face and the opportunities that will add the most value to Discord. You'll deepen our understanding of every user cohort, from longtime gamers to new communities, creators, moderators, and teens. And you'll make sure what we ship results in user value for them. As Discord brings more AI-powered experiences to users, you'll ensure they're grounded in real needs and held to a clear, user-centered quality bar. You'll also modernize how research gets done, using AI to increase our speed and reach without losing rigor.
 You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Safety. This person will report to the VP of Product Design and Insights.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Set the research vision and make research a strategic partner. Own the research roadmap across Discord, balancing foundational, generative, and evaluative work and prioritizing by user impact, business impact, and risk. Deliver clear, compelling readouts that shape prioritization and go/no-go calls, and measure research's impact on product outcomes.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
Role Description
 As the Marketing Operations Manager , you will serve as a deeply embedded, data-oriented partner to the Marketing team and help the business understand and driv e performance across the Marketing-to-Revenue funnel.
 You will analyze the funnel from marketing engagement through qualification, pipeline, and revenue. You’re focused on identifying growth opportunities, conversion gaps, leakage, handoff issues and translating those findings into clear recommendations for Marketing, SDR, Sales, and RevOps leaders.
 This is not a traditional reporting or martech administration role. Your primary value will be your ability to frame ambiguous business questions, diagnose the underlying drivers of performance, distinguish signal from noise, and help cross-functional teams make better operating and investment decisions.
 You will also be expected to use AI and automation extensively to reduce repetitive analytical work, accelerate insight generation, and spend more time on interpretation, problem solving, and decision support.
 Responsibilities
 Own analysis of the Marketing-to-Revenue funnel from engagement and qualification through pipeline progression and revenue.
 Identify opportunities, conversion gaps, funnel leakage, performance anomalies, and handoff issues across Marketing, SDR, and Sales.
 Connect marketing activity to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes to help inform investment and prioritization decisions.
 Build clear analyses and reporting that surface meaningful trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
 Collaborate with cross-functional partners to i mprove lifecycle definitions, lead scoring, routing, SLAs, and measurement frameworks where funnel analysis identifies opportunities.
 Partner with Marketing SLG, RevOps, SDR, Sales, Analytics, and Systems teams to resolve cross-functional funnel and data-quality issues.
